name: PNG Language Program
source: "PNG phonics tracker and bookmarks.xlsx" — 'tracker' sheet (level / letter / sound columns), cross-checked against its 'Junior bookmarks' and 'senior bookmarks' sheets, the per-level bookmark filenames, and the printed "Tracker draft A" sheet
licence_note: Ordering of taught correspondences only (facts); no worksheet artwork, clipart or lesson text included

units.label: Level 1
units.notes: SATPIN — the source's own label for this level

units.label: Level 2
units.notes: both th sounds are introduced together; the source prints two separate th bookmarks (voiceless thin / voiced this)

units.label: Level 3
units.notes: second visit to e, this time saying its long sound; y here is the /igh/ of "my"

units.label: Level 7
units.notes: both oo sounds together (food / cook), the source prints a bookmark for each

units.label: Level 8
units.notes: second visit to y, this time the consonant /y/ of "yes"

units.label: Level 9
units.notes: ie is taught here for the /ee/ of "chief"; the tracker writes er as a schwa-r, but the level's own bookmark is plain er

units.label: Level 10
units.notes: the whole split-digraph family in one level, y_e ("type") included

units.label: Level 11
units.notes: an alternative-spellings-for-long-a level; the source repeats the ai bookmark from Level 8 here as revision, so ai is listed as review rather than taught twice

units.label: Level 13
units.notes: two ou bookmarks, one per sound (round / you)

units.label: Level 15
units.notes: the 'Junior bookmarks' sheet prints eigh in this slot; the tracker and the 'senior bookmarks' sheet both say ght, so ght is used here

accuracy_note: The spreadsheet's own sound column is corrupted for nine consonants — it lists the voiced partner instead of the sound taught (t as /d/, p as /b/, c and ck as /g/, j as /ch/, f and ph as /v/). The printed "Tracker draft A" sheet has the correct sounds and agrees with the primary correspondences used here; "Tracker draft B" carries the same corruption as the spreadsheet. Levels and grapheme order are unaffected — only that one column was wrong.
notes: A 16-level cumulative grapheme sequence. Levels 1-7 are single letters plus the first digraphs; 8-16 move through vowel teams, split digraphs and the rarer spellings. Four graphemes it teaches (y_e, ght, eu, gh) were added to data/gpcs.json for this sequence.
